name: I Am Only Joking
overview: Scripture warns against treating sin and foolishness lightly, as seen in Proverbs where fools mock sin and engage in mischief as sport, lacking true understanding. Wise speech, characterized by gentle and knowledgeable words, contrasts sharply with the reckless and angry outbursts of fools, which only stir conflict and unrest. The imagery of a madman casting firebrands illustrates how careless jesting or foolish words can spread harm, emphasizing the need for wisdom and restraint in all communication.
